IMPORT.TITLE: Bulk Import Prices
IMPORT.HINT: Paste rows of price,barcode or pick a CSV file. The header row is optional and ignored.
IMPORT.IN_PROGRESS_BODY: An import is already running for this label. Please wait for it to finish.
IMPORT.MODE_ADD_UPDATE_DESC: Add new price overrides and update existing ones. Existing barcodes not in the import file are kept as-is.
IMPORT.MODE_OVERRIDE_DESC: Replace existing price overrides for products in the import file. Barcodes not in the file are left untouched.
IMPORT.MODE_ADD_ONLY_DESC: Only add brand-new barcodes. Skip any rows whose barcode already has a price override.
IMPORT.REQ_FIELD_HEADER: First row may be a header (price, barcode); auto-detected and skipped
IMPORT.MODE_HINT_OVERRIDE: Override: Replace prices for the listed barcodes
IMPORT.MODE_HINT_ADD_ONLY: Add Only: Skip barcodes that already have a price
IMPORT.TIP: Use "Add or Update" for most imports — it merges your new prices with existing ones safely. Only use "Override" when you want to fully replace prices for the listed barcodes.
IMPORT.HINT_OPTIONS: Paste rows of price,name or pick a CSV/XLSX file. Match by the option's display name (e.g. Small, Medium, Large).
IMPORT.REQ_FIELD_OPTION_NAME: Option name (must match an existing option's display name — case-insensitive)
